"With a grateful heart, I look forward to my final year of service as your proud representative," Pelosi said in a video, addressing San Franciscans.
Pelosi has been in Congress since 1987 and became the first female Speaker of the House, a role she held from 2007 to 2011 and from 2019 to 2023.
The congresswoman is currently serving in her 20th congressional term and is 86 years old.

Pelosi has disclosed over 200 trades since 2014, totaling more than $225 million, according to data from Quiver Quantitative.

When Pelosi leaves Congress, she will no longer be required to disclose the stock and options trading activity of her husband. This could mean that investors have seen the last trades ever disclosed by the former Speaker of the House.
